sents.t: The City Museum is pleased to announce a new exhibit, "Toys Through Time," opening on September 5.
The exhibit features more than 300 toys from the last 150 years.
Visitors can play with copies of some of the toys in a special hands-on area.
Admission to the exhibit is included in the regular museum ticket.
Children under 12 enter for free, and so do adults who can beat the museum director at a spinning-top contest.
